newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle Friday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle Friday roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was quiet on Friday. No sales slaughter steers or heifers confirmed. Inquiry and demand rather light, USDA said.
Feedlots were current and seller interest generally light at present price levels, few bids 65.00, asking prices mostly 67.00-68.00. Last sales of significant quanity on Tuesday, July 29, at 66.00.
Confirmed: none last week: 700 last year: 1,400
Sales confirmed this week on 98,200 cattle including 36,100 head or about 37 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
